pricing.heading: Pricing that adapts to your business
pricing.description: Rooman Billing natively accommodates five distinct monetization models with zero custom coding and deterministic calculation accuracy.
pricing.flat_note: Flat platform rate covers all included usage & seats
pricing.steps_subtitle: Base Price → Quantity → Discount → Tax → Final Price

models.title: Flat Fee
models.desc: Predictable, static recurring billing on regular intervals (e.g. ₹299/month).

models.title: Per Unit
models.desc: Linear pricing calculated by multiplying unit price by active user count or license seats.

models.title: Volume
models.desc: Total volume purchased qualifies all units for a discounted tier price.

models.title: Tiered / Graduated
models.desc: Units are priced progressively within discrete range brackets as volume expands.

models.title: Package
models.desc: Predefined blocks of units with fixed bundled pricing and overage support.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Clear answers to common questions about Rooman Billing's architecture, models, and operations.

items.q: How does Rooman Billing ensure calculation accuracy?
items.a: Rooman Billing uses deterministic Decimal/NUMERIC arithmetic across all database layers and domain services. We strictly avoid floating-point shortcuts, guaranteeing exact penny and paisa totals across volume tiers, graduated brackets, and GST splits (CGST, SGST, IGST).

items.q: Can we convert quotes directly into invoices and collect payments?
items.a: Yes. Accepted quotes convert into fully compliant tax invoices with one click. Invoices immediately receive a secure, tokenized public link where clients can review itemized line items and complete payment seamlessly.

items.q: How does multi-tenant security and data isolation work?
items.a: Every single record in Rooman Billing is scoped strictly to your Organization ID. Cross-tenant access is prohibited at both the database query layer and application service tier, verified by rigorous IDOR security audits.

items.q: Does Rooman Billing handle complex CPQ and approval rules?
items.a: Yes. Our built-in CPQ engine validates product bundle compatibility and flags discount thresholds that exceed policy, automatically submitting deals to designated managers before quotes can be released.

items.q: Can we track billable project hours and invoice them directly?
items.a: Yes. Rooman Billing features integrated project tracking and employee timesheets. Billable hours undergo supervisor review and can be converted directly into itemized invoice line items.
